I even sank a bunch of cash into this wild startup idea – seemed brilliant at the time, but looking back, maybe it was a bit reckless. Then, out of nowhere, everything just… crashed. For the past three months, it’s like a different person took over. I just don’t care anymore, even about my biggest projects. My mind races even when I'm trying to sleep, and it takes forever to actually drift off. During the day, it's impossible to focus on anything, whether I’m editing a video or just trying to watch a show. Honestly, some days I spend just thinking about how it would all end, really specific scenarios, you know? It's all just so overwhelming, and I can't seem to get a grip on any of it."

    B. Schizophrenia
    C. Bipolar I Disorder
    D. Posttraumatic Stress Disorder
